main.title: Broadcom's custom ASIC biz adds South Korea's FuriosaAI to its empire
main.body:
Broadcom has partnered with South Korea-based FuriosaAI to develop advanced AI accelerators using the company's specialized packaging technology. The collaboration represents another significant relationship for Broadcom's increasingly profitable custom silicon business.

FuriosaAI will adapt its Tensor Contraction Processor technology into a multi-die system-on-package designed for high-volume AI inference workloads. The third-generation chips will be fabricated on a 2nm process and incorporate 'dual layer' HBM4 or HBM4e memory enabled by Broadcom's advanced packaging.

The new processors leverage Broadcom's Extreme Dimension System in Package (3.5D XDSiP) technology, which disaggregates compute, memory, I/O, and logic into distinct chiplets assembled using 3D packaging techniques like hybrid bonding — similar to AMD's MI300 architecture.

Beyond the current eight-chip limitation, FuriosaAI's systems will employ Broadcom's Ethernet and PCIe products, potentially utilizing high-radix switches like the Tomahawk 6 for scaling networks.

FuriosaAI's second-gen RNGD accelerators offer 512 teraFLOPS of FP8 compute, 48GB of HBM3, and consume just 180 watts — significantly less power than competitors like Nvidia's B200, though with correspondingly lower performance. Customers include LG, running its Exaone models on RNGD.

Custom accelerator IP now accounts for 65% of Broadcom's revenue in Q1 2026, reflecting the company's emergence as critical infrastructure behind modern AI chip development. This partnership follows earlier announcements of Broadcom relationships with Meta and Google.

Sampling of the third-generation chip is scheduled to begin in the first half of 2028.
main.keep_reason: Tier 1 Korean competitor Furiosa partners with Broadcom for 2nm/HBM4 3rd-gen accelerator using 3.5D XDSiP packaging + Ethernet/PCIe scale-out — direct competitive intel on DPU/SmartNIC adjacent rack-scale inference platform.
main.select_reason: Tier 1 Korean competitor signing with Broadcom on 2nm/HBM4/3.5D XDSiP with Ethernet+PCIe scale-out fabric is the single biggest story of the day for MangoBoost's space — directly adjacent to DPU/SmartNIC rack-scale inference platforms and modeled on AMD MI300-style chiplet disaggregation.

main.title: 리벨리온, KB금융그룹과 AI 인프라 협력
main.body:
리벨리온(Rebellions)이 KB금융그룹과 금융 AI 인프라 협력을 위한 전략적 파트너십을 체결했다. 양사는 금융권 특화 AI 반도체 추론 인프라 구축에 협력하며, 리벨리온은 AI 반도체 추론 인프라를 공급하고 KB금융은 금융 서비스 지원 및 자금 조달 역할을 맡기로 했다.

금융권은 망분리 규제가 적용돼 내부망을 사용해야 한다. 이에 따라 클라우드 서비스보다 온프레미스 방식의 AI 인프라 수요가 높다. 리벨리온은 이 점을 활용해 금융권 실증 경험을 쌓겠다는 전략이다.

KB금융그룹은 리벨리온의 시리즈 A 투자 이후 꾸준히 지원해 온 투자자로, 리벨리온의 기업 가치를 3조4000억원으로 끌어올리고 국가성장펀드 첫 직접 투자 기업으로 선정되는 데 기여했다.

리벨리온 박성현 대표는 '기술이 금융을 키우고, 금융이 기술 인프라를 바꾸는 선순환의 첫 걸음'이라고 말하며 '한국산 AI 반도체가 금융권에 뿌리내리는 첫 단추'라고 강조했다.

협약은 5월 27일 KB금융그룹 양종희 회장과 리벨리온 박성현 대표 간에 서명됐으며, 구체적인 재무 조건은 공개되지 않았다.
main.keep_reason: Tier 1 Korean competitor Rebellions enters financial sector with on-prem AI inference infra deal with KB Financial — sovereign AI / 국가성장펀드 첫 직접 투자 기업 angle directly in MangoBoost strategic core.
main.select_reason: Tier 1 Korean competitor pushing into 망분리-bound financial sector on-prem inference; 국가성장펀드 첫 직접투자 기업 angle and KB 시리즈 A 이후 누적 투자 맥락은 sovereign-AI 정책 흐름과 정확히 겹친다.

main.title: AI costs begin to bite as agents may increase token demand by 24 times
main.body:
A Goldman Sachs report warns that agentic AI could increase token demand by 24 times over the next few years, pushing major technology companies to reconsider their AI spending strategies. Microsoft and Uber are among firms experiencing severe cost pressures as they grapple with mounting expenses that don't correlate with tangible productivity gains.

Uber's CTO reported the company depleted its entire 2026 AI budget within months. The company's operations chief noted there was 'no link between higher token usage and a proportional increase in consumer features with real benefits.'

Microsoft revoked developer access to Claude Code and plans to transition users to its internal Copilot CLI tool by June 30 — a move appearing financially motivated ahead of the fiscal year close.

Despite aggressive AI adoption (Uber reported 80% of engineers using agentic AI with 60% AI-generated code), companies struggle to demonstrate measurable returns. Similar adoption rates at Airbnb and Google haven't translated to clear cost justification.

While Nvidia's forthcoming Vera Rubin platform promises significant efficiency improvements, over 50% of announced Blackwell data center projects have been cancelled or delayed. Major cloud providers now plan six-year hardware lifecycles, making rapid upgrades unlikely.

The fundamental problem: token cost increases outpace hardware efficiency gains that remain years away from meaningful deployment.
main.keep_reason: Goldman Sachs report on agentic AI token demand exploding 24x, Blackwell project cancellation rate 50%+, hyperscaler 6-year hardware lifecycle — core AI infra cost/efficiency narrative directly relevant to MangoBoost's DPU value prop.
main.select_reason: Goldman Sachs 24x 토큰 수요 전망 + Uber/Microsoft 비용 압박 사례 + Blackwell 프로젝트 50% 취소/지연 + 6년 하드웨어 수명 주기 — DPU offload value prop이 정확히 다루는 인프라 비용 효율 narrative를 한 기사에 응축.

main.title: Snowflake to burn $6B on AWS Graviton CPUs and AI infra
main.body:
Snowflake announced plans to invest $6 billion over five years in Amazon's custom Graviton CPUs and AI accelerators. The commitment amounts to approximately $1.2 billion annually.

CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy stated the goal is to help 'enterprises bring AI directly to governed data' while enabling them to 'move faster, operate with greater density and create measurable impact.'

The investment focuses on addressing a critical gap in AI infrastructure. While large language models run on GPUs, the supporting tools and functions — such as SQL queries and Python scripts — rely on CPU cores. This has driven renewed demand for processing capacity, as each AI agent's performance depends on how quickly the CPU can handle requests.

Under this agreement, Snowflake will run and train its GenAI services using combined GPU and Graviton resources. The company's Cortex AI platform converts natural language to SQL queries, summarizes data, and performs sentiment analysis.

Snowflake's stock rallied more than 30 percent in after-hours trading following the announcement. This suggests investor confidence that AI-driven tools will justify the infrastructure spending, given that Snowflake's lifetime AWS marketplace sales have exceeded $7 billion, with $2 billion in 2025 alone.

The deal places Snowflake alongside Apple and Meta as one of AWS's largest customers for CPU-based computing. Amazon CEO Andy Jassy previously claimed the company's proprietary chips deliver 'better price-performance' than Nvidia's offerings for many workloads.
main.keep_reason: $6B/5yr Snowflake commitment to AWS Graviton CPUs + AI accelerators signals hyperscaler in-house silicon momentum and CPU-side bottleneck for agentic AI — DPU offload thesis adjacent.
main.select_reason: $6B/5년 Graviton+AI 가속기 commitment + 30% AH 주가 급등 + 'AI 에이전트의 CPU 측 병목' 명시 — 하이퍼스케일러 자체 실리콘 momentum과 DPU offload 가치 narrative를 동시에 강화하는 시장 신호.

main.title: GPUs And RAM Are In Short Supply, But The Real Bottleneck For AI Is Electricians
main.body:
While GPUs and RAM shortages dominate headlines, the article contends that skilled electricians represent the actual constraint limiting AI datacenter expansion. This insight emerges from an examination of TeraWulf's massive Lake Mariner facility near Buffalo, New York.

TeraWulf pivoted from cryptocurrency mining to AI/HPC operations, expanding its Lake Mariner site to 157 acres with targets reaching 750 megawatts of capacity. The facility features:
- CB-4 building: 330,000 square feet, 200-megawatt capacity with four data halls
- CB-5 building: 330,000 square feet under construction, with Fluidstack contracted for 160 megawatts
- Infrastructure investment: $290 million spent with Schneider Electric and Motivair on electrical systems, cooling, and related equipment

The construction operates continuously with approximately 1,800 tradespeople on-site simultaneously. Critically, '650 to 800 are electricians,' according to operations leadership. This massive electrical workforce requirement reflects the specialized demands of modern AI datacenters.

Building expenses differ markedly between mining and AI operations:
- Bitcoin mining infrastructure: ~$500,000 per megawatt
- AI/HPC infrastructure: '$7 million to $10 million per megawatt,' reflecting liquid cooling requirements and complexity

Datacenter rental averages '$140 per kilowatt per month' with typical contracts spanning 10-15 years.

The Lake Mariner site benefits from dual 345-kilovolt power feeds providing Tier 3 equivalence redundancy. Notably, the regional power mix is '89 percent zero carbon,' leveraging Niagara Falls hydropower resources.
main.keep_reason: TeraWulf Lake Mariner case: AI/HPC datacenter costs $7-10M/MW vs $500K/MW for crypto, 650-800 electricians on-site — concrete AI datacenter power/labor bottleneck data MangoBoost teams need for infra-cost narrative.
main.select_reason: TeraWulf Lake Mariner 케이스로 AI 데이터센터 단가 $7-10M/MW(크립토 대비 14-20배) + 현장 전기공 650-800명 + 액침 냉각 비용 구조를 구체 숫자로 짚는, infra-cost narrative에 그대로 인용 가능한 1차 자료.

main.title: LG에너지솔루션, 북미 ESS 2.4조원 공급 계약 체결…오라클 AI 데이터센터 지원
main.body:
LG에너지솔루션이 미국 미시간주 디트로이트 소재 대형 유틸리티 기업 DTE에너지와 6GWh 규모의 ESS(에너지저장장치) 배터리 공급 계약을 체결했다. 계약 규모는 약 16억 달러(약 2조4000억원)이며, 계약 기간은 약 2년이다.

이번 배터리는 오라클의 AI 데이터센터 프로젝트를 포함한 여러 전력망 개발 사업에 활용된다. 오라클은 미시간주 세일라인 타운십에 AI 데이터센터를 구축할 예정이다.

AIDC(AI 데이터센터)는 대규모 서버와 냉각 설비가 24시간 가동돼 전력 사용량이 크고 순간적인 부하 변동도 빈번해 안정적인 전력 공급이 중요하다. ESS는 이러한 대규모 전력 수요를 안정적으로 충당하는 핵심 인프라 역할을 한다.

LG에너지솔루션은 이번 배터리를 주로 미국 미시간주 홀랜드 공장에서 생산할 계획이다. 현재 북미 ESS 생산 거점 5곳을 운영 중이며, 올해 말까지 글로벌 ESS 생산 능력을 60GWh 이상으로 확대하고, 이 중 80% 이상을 북미에 집중 배치할 방침이다.
main.keep_reason: LG Energy Solution $1.6B/6GWh ESS supply to DTE for Oracle Michigan AIDC — AI datacenter power supply chain story with Korean industry tie-in, directly tied to AIDC 24/7 부하 변동/안정 전력 challenge.
main.select_reason: 16억 달러(약 2.4조원)/6GWh ESS 공급 + Oracle 미시간 AIDC 직결 + 북미 ESS 생산 80% 집중 — 한국 산업 supply-chain과 AIDC 전력 안정화 challenge를 잇는 드문 한국발 datacenter projects 기사.

main.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B at $25B pre-money valuation
main.body:
Cognition, creator of the autonomous AI coding agent Devin, announced a $1 billion funding round at a $25 billion pre-money valuation. Led by Lux Capital and General Catalyst, the round more than doubled the company's valuation from its $10.2 billion post-money valuation in September 2025.

The company reports impressive metrics: '$492 million in annualized revenue run-rate' with enterprise customer adoption growing '50% month-over-month for the past six months.' Major clients include Mercedes-Benz, NASA, Goldman Sachs, and Santander.

New investors Ribbit Capital, Atreides, and Layer Global joined existing backers including Founders Fund and 8VC.

The funding signals investor confidence that independent AI coding startups can thrive alongside major model makers like Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex. Cognition previously acquired the remaining assets of rival coding platform Windsurf.

This represents significant growth from their previous round — a major leap from its $10.2 billion post-money valuation when it closed a $400 million funding round just eight months ago in September. Enterprise usage has increased more than ten times over since the beginning of the year.
main.keep_reason: Devin maker Cognition $1B/$25B valuation + $492M ARR + 50% MoM enterprise growth — agentic coding demand signal that anchors the broader token-demand story (pairs with Tom's 24x token piece).
main.select_reason: $1B 신규 조달 + $25B pre-money(8개월 만에 2.5배) + $492M ARR + 8개월 만에 엔터프라이즈 사용량 10배 — Goldman 24x 토큰 수요 narrative의 수요 측 증거를 정확히 집어주는 페어링 기사.

main.title: SKT, AI 에이전트 서비스 사내 적용…'A.dot Biz Cowork' 베타 운영
main.body:
SK텔레콤이 AI 에이전트 서비스 'A.dot Biz Cowork'를 사내에 베타 형태로 도입했다. 이 서비스는 직원들이 AI에게 자신의 업무 방식을 가르치면, AI가 이를 반복 실행해 일상 업무를 자동화해 준다.

주요 기능으로는 자율 실행(AI가 자체 실행 계획을 만들고 코드 작성 및 결과 검증 수행), 문서 처리(수십 개의 사양 문서나 제안서를 읽고 필요 조건을 추출해 비교표 작성), 협업툴 연동(아웃룩, Teams 등 내부 협업 도구와 연결, 추후 점진적 확장 예정) 등이 있다.

SK텔레콤은 또한 AXMS(AX Management System)를 버전 1.5로 업그레이드하고 'AX 챌린지' 이니셔티브를 공식화해 혁신 가속화를 추진하고 있다. 회사는 직원들이 AI 도구를 개발하고 이를 구현해 통합 시스템을 통해 혁신 아이디어를 발굴하는 선순환 구조를 구축하겠다는 목표다.
main.keep_reason: SKT enterprise agentic AI deployment (자율 실행, 문서 처리, Outlook/Teams 연동) + AXMS 1.5 + AX 챌린지 — Korean conglomerate operationalizing AI agents, signals enterprise inference demand.
main.select_reason: 한국 대기업의 사내 agentic AI 정식 도입 + Outlook/Teams 연동 + AXMS 1.5 — 한국 엔터프라이즈 추론 수요 신호로서 collaboration 카테고리에 유일하게 들어맞는 picks이며 카테고리 분산을 5/5로 완성.

competitor_articles.title: FuriosaAI Partners with Broadcom to Build Next-generation Inference Platform for the Agentic Era
competitor_articles.body:
FuriosaAI announced a strategic partnership with Broadcom to develop a third-generation AI accelerator chip. The collaboration combines FuriosaAI's Tensor Contraction Processor architecture with Broadcom's networking expertise and infrastructure capabilities.

Current Product: FuriosaAI's RNGD chip is currently in mass production at TSMC's 5nm process. The device operates at 180W and handles LLM and agentic AI workloads, with validation from companies including Samsung SDS and LG AI Research.

Next-Generation Design: The third-generation chip will feature a 2nm compute die with HBM4/4E memory, utilizing Broadcom's advanced packaging to integrate multiple silicon dies. The system incorporates Broadcom's Ethernet and PCIe technologies for rack-scale networking.

Development Focus: According to leadership, the partnership addresses 'the key bottlenecks of large-scale agentic AI' by prioritizing 'high-bandwidth data movement rather than the thread management required by GPUs.'

Timeline: Sampling is scheduled for the first half of 2028.

Software: FuriosaAI's SDK features an automatic compiler mapping PyTorch code to silicon, plus a Virtual ISA for developers requiring granular hardware control.

FuriosaAI was founded in 2017 by veteran engineers from AMD, Qualcomm, and Samsung, with offices in Korea and Silicon Valley. To date, the company has raised approximately $115 million across four funding rounds.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Broadcom IR-sourced detail on Furiosa RNGD mass production at TSMC 5nm, Samsung SDS/LG validation, SDK/Virtual ISA, $115M raised — IR-grade primary substance complements The Register angle, dedup not warranted.
